summary: Implemented the window-title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py, and test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, with assertions skipped on win32. Not run, per instructions: tests, mypy, and Black are unverified. No commits made.
